selection: grouped 5-fold CV over training engines; see docs/EVALUATION_RESULTS.md

input_contract.note: Only the listed sensors are read; operational settings and uninformative sensors are ignored.

output_contract.note: values near 125 mean 'healthy, no usable estimate', not a measured remaining life

drift_baseline.healthy_definition: first 30 cycles of every training engine
drift_baseline.degradation_definition: sign of (mean over last 30 cycles before failure minus healthy mean)
